note: Master SKU catalog transcribed from the Craftable item list. Wine section complete. Liquor, Beer and NA Bev still to be added. 'cues' are the visual features that distinguish this bottle in a shelf photo — capsule colour first, because a capsule is often all the camera sees. 'confidence' is how sure the cue description is; 'needs_photo' items would benefit from one reference shot.

champagne.desc: heavy, deep punt, foil over cage

items.name: Roseblood Rose 750ml
items.cues: Very pale salmon wine, clear glass. Ornate oval label reading ROSEBLOOD D'ESTOUBLON. Grey/pewter capsule.

items.name: Saracina Chardonnay 750ml
items.cues: Mendocino producer. Cases are black-and-white printed SARACINA / MENDOCINO COUNTY.

items.name: Laurent Perrier Cuvee Rose 750ml
items.cues: Unmistakable: squat rounded bottle wrapped in a wire cage-like decorative net. Salmon-pink wine.

items.name: Moet Imperial Rose 187ml
items.cues: Mini. Gold foil neck, RED crown seal, black label with gold ribbon X. Rose version — label reads ROSE IMPERIAL.

items.name: Accademia Prosecco 750ml
items.cues: TRANSPARENT COLOURED GLASS — blue, red, green, orange, yellow or purple. Bottega's Accademia line. Nothing else on the shelf looks like this.

items.name: Grande Dame 750ml
items.cues: Veuve Clicquot's prestige cuvee. Heavier bottle than Yellow Label, cream/white label, gold accents. Not the orange label.

items.name: Ferrari Rose 375ml
items.cues: Half bottle. Copper/rose foil, black label with gold FERRARI script, TRENTODOC.

items.name: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label W/ Fridge 750ml
items.cues: Gift pack — bottle in an orange metal 'fridge' tin. Counts as one unit. Only distinguishable from plain Yellow Label when the tin is present.

items.name: Une Femme 187ml
items.cues: Clear glass split, CROWN CAP (not foil), amber-rose liquid. Plain white rectangular label.

items.name: Scharffenberger 750ml
items.cues: NAVY/PURPLE foil. Grey-silver label with small yellow flowers. Reads BRUT EXCELLENCE.

items.name: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label Reserve 750ml
items.cues: Orange label, gold foil neck banded 'Veuve Clicquot'. Reserve differs from standard only in label text.

items.name: Chandon Brut Rose 187ml
items.cues: Mini. Pink/salmon wine. Chandon label, green-tinted glass.

items.name: Cakebread Chardonnay 750ml
items.cues: Cream label, green grape-leaf illustration, CAKEBREAD CELLARS in serif. Chardonnay vs Sauv Blanc differs only in the varietal line.

items.name: Albrecht Cremant Brut Rose 750ml
items.cues: PINK foil. Deep red label, LUCIEN ALBRECHT, CREMANT D'ALSACE BRUT ROSE.

items.name: Cliff Lede Sauvignon Blanc 19 750ml
items.cues: Napa. Clean modern label.

items.name: Neiman Marcus Chardonnay 750ml
items.cues: BLACK label, gold/white script NEIMAN MARCUS, Mendocino County. Dark capsule. Cork branded Neiman Marcus.

items.name: Clos Pegase Chardonnay Mitsuko19 750ml
items.cues: Mitsuko's Vineyard, Carneros. Clos Pegase uses artwork-style labels.

items.name: Terlato Pinot Grigio 750ml
items.cues: Tall slim Germanic/Alsace-style bottle typical of Friuli Pinot Grigio.

items.name: Dom Perignon Luminous 750ml
items.cues: Luminous edition — label has an LED backlight panel and a battery tab. Dark green bottle, shield label.

items.name: Miraval Cotes De Provence Rose 375ml
items.cues: Half bottle. Distinctive curved 'hourglass' Provence bottle. GOLD capsule, pale salmon.

items.name: Attems Pino Grigio 750ml
items.cues: GREY/SILVER capsule printed ATTEMS. White label with a small crest. Friuli DOC.

items.name: Daou Cabernet Sauvignon 750ml
items.cues: White label, DAOU in serif caps, Paso Robles. Standard bottling.

items.name: Daou Cabernet Reserve 750ml
items.cues: Reserve tier — darker/heavier label than the standard Cabernet. Same DAOU wordmark. Easy to confuse with W22; read the tier line.

items.name: Whispering Angel Rose 375ml
items.cues: Half bottle. GOLD CHECKERBOARD capsule, white label with script. Chateau d'Esclans.

items.name: LYRE'S CLASSICO 750ml
items.cues: Non-alcoholic sparkling. Lyre's house style — black label, gold lyre emblem.

items.name: Cherry Pie Pinot Noir 750ml
items.cues: Cherry-red label graphic. Same importer family as Belle Glos but NOT wax-dipped.

items.name: Bottega Prosecco 750ml
items.cues: GOLD METALLIC opaque bottle — fully metallised, no visible glass. Bottega Gold. Distinct from Accademia (coloured transparent glass).

items.name: Joto Yuzu Flavored Sake 720ml
items.cues: 720ml sake bottle. Yuzu — pale cloudy yellow liquid.

items.name: Whispering Angel Rose 750ml
items.cues: GOLD CHECKERBOARD capsule, tall tapered Provence bottle, white label with script. Your highest-volume rose.

items.name: Sonoma Cutrer Chardonnay 750ml
items.cues: BRIGHT YELLOW capsule — the most distinctive capsule on the shelf. White label, RUSSIAN RIVER RANCHES.

items.name: Une Femme Callie Sparkling Rose 187ml
items.cues: Clear glass split, crown cap, amber-rose. Label reads UNE FEMME / THE CALLIE.

items.name: Veuve Clicquot Yellow Label 750ml
items.cues: ORANGE label, gold foil neck banded 'Veuve Clicquot'. The default Veuve.

items.name: Sparkling Sangria 750ml
items.cues: Brand not identified from the item name alone.

items.name: Trapiche Malbec 750ml
items.cues: Argentine Malbec. Trapiche label.

items.name: Moet Brut Imperial 750ml
items.cues: Full size. Gold foil, RED crown seal, black label with gold ribbon X. MOET & CHANDON.

items.name: Bisol Jeio Prosecco 750ml
items.cues: GOLD label with Jeio in script, embossed circular 'B' medallion on the glass, PROSECCO D.O.C. BRUT. Neck foil black/gold or rope-pattern.

items.name: Dom Perignon 10 750ml
items.cues: 2010 vintage. Dark green bottle, shield-shaped label. Non-luminous.

items.name: Une Femme The Callie Sparkling Rose Neiman Marcus 187ml
items.cues: Neiman Marcus co-branded version of W31. Visually near-identical — check for NM branding on the label.

items.name: Studio Rose 2021 750ml
items.cues: Likely Studio by Miraval. Vintage-dated 2021.

items.name: Moet Imperial 187ml
items.cues: Mini. Gold foil, RED crown seal, black label, MINI MOET on the body. Brut (white) not Rose.

items.name: Jaume Serra Cristalino Brut 750ml
items.cues: Spanish cava. Value bottling — lighter glass than champagne.

items.name: Cakebread Sauvignon Blanc 750ml
items.cues: Cream label, green grape-leaf illustration, SAUVIGNON BLANC / NORTH COAST. Pale yellow-green wine, clear glass.

items.name: Cuvaison Chardonnay 750ml
items.cues: Cream/white label, minimalist mark, ESTATE GROWN EST 1969, Los Carneros. Dark green glass.

items.name: Joto Yuzu Sake 500ml
items.cues: 500ml. Same Joto Yuzu product as W28 in a smaller format — separate SKU, do not merge.

items.name: Belle Glos Pinot Noir 750ml
items.cues: RED WAX-DIPPED capsule, thick and dripping. The single most recognisable bottle in the room — no other product looks like it.

items.name: Duckhorn Cabernet Sauvignon 18 750ml
items.cues: Napa. Cream label with a duck illustration.

items.name: Miraval Cotes De Provence Rose 750ml
items.cues: Full size. Distinctive curved 'hourglass' bottle, GOLD capsule, pale salmon.

items.name: Tyku Cucumber Sake 330ml
items.cues: Small format. TYKU uses a frosted/coloured bottle; cucumber expression is green-tinted.

items.name: Heavensake Sake Baby 300ml
items.cues: 300ml 'baby' format. Heavensake — minimalist white label, designed by Regis Camus.

items.name: Wolffer Spring In A Bottle 750ml
items.cues: Non-alcoholic. Wolffer Estate. Round white label with a DAFFODIL illustration, reads SPRING IN A BOTTLE. Rose-coloured liquid.
